diseases.name: Apple - Apple Scab
diseases.symptoms: Olive-green to brown spots on leaves and fruits. Premature leaf drop.
diseases.treatment: Apply Mancozeb or Captan fungicide. Remove infected leaves. Improve air circulation.
diseases.prevention: Use resistant varieties. Apply fungicide at bud break. Avoid overhead irrigation.

diseases.name: Apple - Black Rot
diseases.symptoms: Brown rotting of fruits with black pycnidia. Leaf spots with purple margins.
diseases.treatment: Remove mummified fruits. Apply Captan or Thiophanate-methyl. Prune infected branches.
diseases.prevention: Sanitation of orchard. Remove dead wood. Apply protective fungicide sprays.

diseases.name: Apple - Cedar Apple Rust
diseases.symptoms: Bright orange-yellow spots on upper leaf surface. Tube-like structures on lower surface.
diseases.treatment: Apply Myclobutanil or Propiconazole fungicide. Remove nearby cedar trees if possible.
diseases.prevention: Plant resistant apple varieties. Apply fungicide from pink stage through June.

diseases.name: Apple - Healthy
diseases.symptoms: No disease symptoms. Healthy green leaves.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Maintain good agricultural practices.
diseases.prevention: Regular monitoring. Balanced fertilization. Proper irrigation.

diseases.name: Corn - Cercospora Leaf Spot
diseases.symptoms: Rectangular gray lesions with tan centers on leaves. Lesions parallel to leaf veins.
diseases.treatment: Apply Azoxystrobin or Propiconazole. Rotate crops. Use resistant hybrids.
diseases.prevention: Crop rotation. Residue management. Plant tolerant varieties.

diseases.name: Corn - Common Rust
diseases.symptoms: Small, circular to elongated brown pustules on both leaf surfaces.
diseases.treatment: Apply Triazole fungicides. Use resistant hybrids. Early planting.
diseases.prevention: Plant resistant hybrids. Monitor fields regularly. Apply fungicide if needed.

diseases.name: Corn - Northern Leaf Blight
diseases.symptoms: Long, cigar-shaped gray-green lesions on leaves. Lesions turn tan with age.
diseases.treatment: Apply Azoxystrobin or Propiconazole at tasseling. Crop rotation.
diseases.prevention: Use resistant hybrids. Crop rotation. Bury crop residues.

diseases.name: Corn - Healthy
diseases.symptoms: No disease symptoms. Vibrant green leaves.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed.
diseases.prevention: Maintain crop rotation. Regular scouting. Balanced nutrition.

diseases.name: Grape - Black Rot
diseases.symptoms: Tan lesions with dark borders on leaves. Black shriveled mummified berries.
diseases.treatment: Apply Myclobutanil or Mancozeb. Remove mummified berries. Prune infected canes.
diseases.prevention: Sanitation. Apply fungicide from bloom through berry development.

diseases.name: Grape - Esca (Black Measles)
diseases.symptoms: Tiger-stripe pattern on leaves. Berries show dark spots. Internal wood discoloration.
diseases.treatment: Remove infected vines. Apply Sodium arsenite (where permitted). Trunk renewal.
diseases.prevention: Protect pruning wounds. Use disease-free planting material. Avoid stress.

diseases.name: Grape - Leaf Blight
diseases.symptoms: Angular brown lesions on leaves. Lesions may coalesce causing large dead areas.
diseases.treatment: Apply copper-based fungicides. Remove infected leaves. Improve ventilation.
diseases.prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation. Ensure good air circulation. Apply protective sprays.

diseases.name: Grape - Healthy
diseases.symptoms: No disease symptoms.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed.
diseases.prevention: Regular scouting. Proper canopy management. Balanced fertilization.

diseases.name: Rice - Leaf Blast
diseases.symptoms: Diamond or eye-shaped lesions with gray center and brown border on leaves.
diseases.treatment: Apply Tricyclazole or Isoprothiolane. Avoid excess nitrogen. Drain fields.
diseases.prevention: Use blast-resistant varieties. Balanced fertilization. Avoid dense planting.

diseases.name: Rice - Brown Spot
diseases.symptoms: Small brown oval spots on leaves with yellow halo. Seedling blight.
diseases.treatment: Apply Mancozeb or Propiconazole. Seed treatment with fungicide. Balanced nutrition.
diseases.prevention: Treat seeds before sowing. Balanced potassium fertilization. Crop rotation.

diseases.name: Rice - Neck Blast
diseases.symptoms: Rotting at the base of panicle (neck). Panicle falls over. White empty grains.
diseases.treatment: Apply Tricyclazole at booting and heading stage. Avoid late nitrogen application.
diseases.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Time planting to avoid humid weather at heading.

diseases.name: Tomato - Bacterial Spot
diseases.symptoms: Small water-soaked lesions on leaves turning brown. Scabby lesions on fruits.
diseases.treatment: Apply copper-based bactericide. Remove infected plant parts. Avoid overhead watering.
diseases.prevention: Use disease-free seeds. Crop rotation. Avoid working in wet fields.

diseases.name: Tomato - Early Blight
diseases.symptoms: Dark brown concentric ring spots on lower leaves. Yellow halo around lesions.
diseases.treatment: Apply Mancozeb or Chlorothalonil. Remove lower infected leaves. Stake plants.
diseases.prevention: Crop rotation. Mulching. Avoid overhead irrigation. Remove plant debris.

diseases.name: Tomato - Late Blight
diseases.symptoms: Large irregular water-soaked lesions. White mold on underside in humid conditions.
diseases.treatment: Apply Metalaxyl + Mancozeb. Remove infected plants immediately. Avoid overhead watering.
diseases.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Avoid overhead irrigation. Apply fungicide preventively.

diseases.name: Tomato - Leaf Mold
diseases.symptoms: Pale green to yellow spots on upper leaf. Olive-green velvety mold on underside.
diseases.treatment: Apply Chlorothalonil or Mancozeb. Improve greenhouse ventilation. Reduce humidity.
diseases.prevention: Resistant varieties. Reduce humidity. Improve air circulation.

diseases.name: Tomato - Septoria Leaf Spot
diseases.symptoms: Small circular spots with dark borders and gray centers. Tiny black dots inside lesions.
diseases.treatment: Apply Mancozeb or Copper fungicide. Remove lower infected leaves.
diseases.prevention: Crop rotation. Mulching. Avoid wetting foliage. Remove plant debris.

diseases.name: Tomato - Spider Mites
diseases.symptoms: Tiny yellow or white stippling on leaves. Fine webbing on undersides. Leaf bronzing.
diseases.treatment: Apply Abamectin or Bifenazate miticide. Use insecticidal soap. Increase humidity.
diseases.prevention: Avoid dusty conditions. Conserve natural enemies. Monitor regularly.

diseases.name: Tomato - Target Spot
diseases.symptoms: Brown lesions with concentric rings on leaves and fruits.
diseases.treatment: Apply Chlorothalonil or Tebuconazole. Improve air circulation.
diseases.prevention: Crop rotation. Debris removal. Avoid overhead irrigation.

diseases.name: Tomato - Yellow Leaf Curl Virus
diseases.symptoms: Upward curling and yellowing of leaves. Stunted growth. Flower drop.
diseases.treatment: No cure. Remove infected plants. Control whitefly vector with Imidacloprid.
diseases.prevention: Use resistant varieties. Control whitefly. Use insect-proof nets.

diseases.name: Tomato - Mosaic Virus
diseases.symptoms: Mosaic pattern of light and dark green on leaves. Distorted growth.
diseases.treatment: No cure. Remove and destroy infected plants. Disinfect tools.
diseases.prevention: Use virus-free seeds. Disinfect tools. Control aphid vectors. Wash hands.

diseases.name: Tomato - Healthy
diseases.symptoms: No disease symptoms. Healthy dark green leaves.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed.
diseases.prevention: Maintain good practices. Regular monitoring. Balanced fertilization.

diseases.name: Potato - Early Blight
diseases.symptoms: Dark brown lesions with concentric rings on older leaves. Yellow halo.
diseases.treatment: Apply Mancozeb or Chlorothalonil. Remove infected leaves. Ensure proper nutrition.
diseases.prevention: Crop rotation. Avoid overhead irrigation. Apply fungicide preventively.

diseases.name: Potato - Late Blight
diseases.symptoms: Dark water-soaked lesions on leaves. White sporulation on underside. Tuber rot.
diseases.treatment: Apply Metalaxyl + Mancozeb immediately. Destroy severely infected plants.
diseases.prevention: Use certified disease-free seed tubers. Plant resistant varieties. Fungicide spray.

diseases.name: Potato - Healthy
diseases.symptoms: No disease symptoms.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed.
diseases.prevention: Use certified seed. Crop rotation. Regular monitoring.
